def safe_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is a single plain file name: non-empty, no path separators, not '.' or '..'."""
    ex safe_name("a.txt") == True
    ex safe_name("../secret") == False
    ex safe_name("sub/a.txt") == False
    ex safe_name("") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    if "/" in name or "\\" in name:
        return False
    return True

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Return the text of file `name` inside the directory `notes`. A name that is not a plain file name, or a missing or unreadable file, gives "". No name may read a file outside `notes`."""
    post out == "" or safe_name(name)
    if not safe_name(name):
        return ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        return fs.read_text(name) else ""
